`clear`: clear the terminal screen.

## Synopsis

<strong>clear</strong>

## Description

<strong>clear</strong> moves the cursor home, erases the screen, and erases the terminal's scrollback, by writing the escape sequences <strong>ESC\[H ESC\[2J ESC\[3J</strong> to standard output, as ncurses' <strong>clear</strong> does. Any arguments are ignored.

## Exit status

Always 0.

## See also

<strong>stty</strong>(1)
